BIOME: Design with an elephant. Scout with a falcon. Review with a goldfish. Map with a cartographer. Build with a beaver. Blend with a chameleon. Inspect with a woodpecker. Clean with the reaper.

Install  ·  Quickstart  ·  Documentation  ·  GitHub


**BIOME** is an autonomous, production-grade software delivery ecosystem for AI coding assistants. Derived from Google's Elephant-Goldfish Model (EGM) and evolved into a multi-agent engineering platform: * **The Elephant** holds deep architectural memory, explores trade-offs, and drafts specifications. *(Strictly barred from writing production code — The Elephant Iron Rule)*. * **The Falcon** performs high-speed, low-token reconnaissance of codebase types and signatures so the Elephant never bloats its context. * **The Goldfish** reviewer swarm red-teams the specification with zero conversation bias. * **The Cartographer** maps codebase topology and caches dependencies in `.biome/codebase_topology.json`. * **The Beaver** builds phase-isolated code modifications partitioned across domain pods (Database, Backend, Web, Mobile) with human-grade craftsmanship. * **The Chameleon** eliminates robotic AI naming, marketing buzzwords in UI, and chatty comments. * **The Woodpecker** audits the raw git diff line-by-line across 5 pecking vectors before commit. * **The Reaper Protocol** terminates and purges completed workers immediately to enforce the Zero-Zombie Invariant. * **You** make the architectural trade-offs, approve specifications, and review execution receipts. --- ## Install Choose your coding agent. Install the complete plugin so its skills and agents can run seamlessly across all environments directly from GitHub: ### Antigravity CLI ```sh agy plugin install https://github.com/asteria-core/biome ``` For the **Antigravity App** and **Antigravity for IDEs** (Visual Studio Code extension), run `/plugin` or see the [installation instructions](docs/harnesses.md#antigravity-app-and-antigravity-for-ides). ### Claude Code Install directly from GitHub via Claude Code CLI: ```sh claude plugin marketplace add asteria-core/biome claude plugin install biome@biome ``` Or inside an active Claude Code session: ```text /plugin install biome --marketplace asteria-core/biome ``` ### Codex CLI Install directly from GitHub via Codex CLI: ```sh codex plugin marketplace add asteria-core/biome codex plugin add biome@biome ``` ### Cursor & Windsurf Install directly into your workspace: ```sh npx skills add asteria-core/biome --agent cursor ``` Start a new session after installation. For other harnesses, see the [setup guide](docs/harnesses.md). --- ## Try your first feature Open your project in your coding agent and run the unified autonomous command `/biome`. You can run the entire pipeline end-to-end automatically: **Autonomous End-to-End Pipeline** ```text /biome Add webhook delivery with retry backoff to this project. ``` `/biome` orchestrates the complete flow automatically: 1. **State Anchor**: Initializes `.biome/state.json` to survive context compaction. 2. **Concept Exploration & Falcon Reconnaissance**: Explores requirements and probes existing interfaces without code dumps. 3. **Elephant Spec Drafting**: The Elephant drafts publication-grade specification under `docs/designs/` (*strictly zero production code*). 4. **Hardened Critic & Goldfish Swarm**: Parallel zero-context audit with `agents/critic.md` attacking UI/UX friction and contracts. 5. **Auto-Resolve Gate**: Closes trivial findings, settles critical trade-offs with user, and marks spec `APPROVED`. 6. **Decoupled Cartography & Indexing**: Reuses `.biome/codebase_topology.json` and emits `.biome/project_index.json` partitioned by domain pods. 7. **Beaver Ephemeral Build**: Executes domain-partitioned mutations (DB -> Backend -> Web/Mobile) with anti-slop human-grade craft. 8. **Woodpecker Code Diff Audit**: Pecks at the raw `git diff` across 5 vectors (spec fidelity, security, edge cases, micro-architecture, anti-slop). 9. **The Reaper Teardown**: Destroys completed worker sessions to ensure unpolluted fresh starts. --- ## Standalone Granular Commands You can also run individual steps using standalone granular commands whenever you want fine-grained control: **Explore the idea** ```text /biome-brainstorm Add webhook delivery to this project. ``` Discuss requirements and trade-offs with the agent. Fresh reviewers challenge the proposal, and the agent saves the agreed direction in `concepts_brief.md`. **Draft the specification** ```text /biome-draft ``` The Elephant turns the brief into `docs/designs/.md`, pausing after each section for your feedback in chat. **Ruthless Critic Review** ```text /biome-critic docs/designs/.md ``` The Cynical Lead Auditor & Adversarial User traces UI/UX states, latency, and edge cases to surface contract flaws. **Review the draft** ```text /biome-review docs/designs/.md ``` Fresh reviewers check the design across 5 stages (comprehension, style, design critique, zoom-out, readiness). **Resolve findings** ```text /biome-resolve docs/designs/.md ``` Negotiate and apply fixes, resolve trade-offs, and secure formal `APPROVED` status. **Deterministic Indexing** ```text /biome-index docs/designs/.md ``` The Indexer checks topology cache and emits `.biome/project_index.json` with domain-partitioned mutation plans. **Build with Beaver** ```text /biome-build ``` The Beaver executes phase-isolated, surgical code modifications according to `.biome/project_index.json`, checks latest package releases, enforces modular micro-architecture, runs local tests, and performs self-healing. **Audit Diff with Woodpecker** ```text /biome-woodpecker docs/designs/.md ``` The Woodpecker audits the raw git diff line-by-line for security vulnerabilities, spec fidelity, and pathological edge cases before committing. See the [workflow guide](docs/getting_started.md) for the full process. --- ## The Animals of BIOME ### The Four Pillar Animals (Emblem Core) The four primary animals form the balanced equilibrium of the BIOME emblem:
Pillar AnimalContext ModeResponsibility
🐘 The ElephantProject context & conversational memoryExplore the problem, draft specifications, and coordinate delivery. Strictly prohibited from writing or editing source code.
🐠 The GoldfishZero-context stateless inspectionStress-test assumptions with fresh eyes and expose edge-case blind spots in specifications.
The BeaverIsolated ephemeral builderExecute surgical code modifications across domain pods (DB, Backend, Web, Mobile) with latest dependencies and tests.
The WoodpeckerZero-context code diff inspectorPeck relentlessly at the raw git diff across 5 vectors (security, fidelity, edge cases, micro-architecture, anti-slop).
### Specialized Auxiliary Operatives & Lifecycle
OperativeContext ModeSpecialized Responsibility
🦅 The FalconRapid reconnaissance scoutProbe codebase entrypoints, signatures, and schemas without polluting the Elephant's context.
🗺️ The CartographerCached repository topology engineMap codebase modules and dependencies once into .biome/codebase_topology.json, eliminating redundant scans.
🦎 The ChameleonAnti-slop & craftsmanship stylistEnforce natural human naming, clean UI microcopy, and purge robotic AI boilerplate.
⚡ The ReaperLifecycle execution protocolTerminate and purge all worker subagent sessions immediately upon task completion (Zero Zombie Invariant).
👤 YouHuman goals & strategic constraintsResolve architectural trade-offs, approve the design, and review execution receipts.
> **Core Architectural Invariants**: > * **Elephant State Anchor**: Durable phase checkpoints are written to `.biome/state.json`. If context compaction occurs, the Elephant immediately re-anchors itself and strictly adheres to the Iron Rule. > * **Subagent Preamble Contract**: Subagents are never called with ad-hoc prompts; each receives its official persona (`agents/*.md`) and execution skill (`skills/*/SKILL.md`) cold. > * **Anti-Slop & Human-Grade Craftsmanship**: Robotic naming (`*Helper`, `*Manager`), AI buzzwords in UI (`seamless`, `empower`), and chatty obvious comments are strictly banned and rejected by the Woodpecker. > * **Multi-Domain Pod Swarm**: Complex cross-stack tasks are partitioned into isolated domain pods (Database -> Backend -> Web/Mobile -> E2E), preventing token blowout. > * **The Reaper Protocol (Zero-Zombie Rule)**: All worker sessions are strictly ephemeral single-use instances. They are terminated and destroyed immediately upon task completion. --- ## Choose a skill You can use each skill when you need it. You do not have to follow the full sequence.
SkillUse it to…
 BIOMERun the autonomous end-to-end delivery ecosystem (/biome).
 BrainstormTest an idea and write a concept brief (/biome-brainstorm).
 DraftTurn a brief or existing notes into a design document (/biome-draft).
 CriticRun the unsparing Critic Goldfish on any spec or feature (/biome-critic).
 ReviewReview a design with fresh agents across five stages (/biome-review).
 ResolveWork through review findings and agree on changes (/biome-resolve).
 IndexerEmit deterministic .biome/project_index.json from spec and code (/biome-index).
 BuildRun standalone Beaver isolated code modifications with tests (/biome-build).
 WoodpeckerAudit code diff and security vulnerabilities before commit (/biome-woodpecker).
 BootstrapCreate or update documentation for an existing codebase (/biome-bootstrap).
 Review loopRun a configured group of reviewers for a specific review task (/biome-review-loop).
 Drift reportCompare checked-in documents with current source code (/biome-drift-report).
--- ## Learn more - [Getting started](docs/getting_started.md): the workflow and project layout. - [Setup](docs/harnesses.md): installation, agent capabilities, and known limits. - [Architecture](https://github.com/asteria-core/biome/blob/main/docs/designs/architecture.md): how skills and reviewers fit together. - [Testing](https://github.com/asteria-core/biome/blob/main/TESTING.md): checks, execution records, and verification limits. ## Contribute Read [contributing](https://github.com/asteria-core/biome/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) for PRs, [issues](https://github.com/asteria-core/biome/issues) for bugs, and [discussions](https://github.com/asteria-core/biome/discussions) for questions. ## License This project is licensed under a dual-licensing structure: * **[BIOME License v1.0 (Source-Available)](LICENSE)**: Copyright © 2026 Asteria Studio. All Rights Reserved. Governs the BIOME multi-agent software engineering ecosystem, agent architectures (Elephant, Goldfish, Beaver, Woodpecker, Falcon, Chameleon), prompts, and orchestration state-machines for personal, academic, and internal non-commercial development. Commercial hosting, SaaS, managed execution, and AI model distillation require a separate commercial license from Asteria Studio. * **[Apache License 2.0](LICENSE-APACHE)**: Upstream base portions Copyright © Google LLC, licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.
